name: KY-037 Sound / Noise Sensor
description: Microphone module with analog and digital outputs. Analog output for volume level; digital output triggers when volume exceeds threshold (adjustable via potentiometer). Useful for noise monitoring and event detection.

signals.name: threshold_exceeded
signals.description: true when sound exceeds hardware threshold

firmwareHint: Sample analog at 100–1000 Hz and compute RMS for a smooth envelope. Digital pin can trigger an interrupt on loud events.
